node.title: Re: Perl code help
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [usertest],

Please use tags to format your input and output - see [id://174051]

There are several ways to do this, here's a quick [doc://perlrun#*-n*|oneliner] using the [doc://$/|input record separator] and a [doc://perlretut|regex]:

perl -wne 'BEGIN{$/=qq{\nEND\n}} print unless /^START$ .* ^def$/xms;' input.txt

Note that this is a little simplistic and will also print data which is outside of the START...END markers.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
